items.title: Conduction of Heat
items.explanation: Heat transfer from a hot object to a cold one occurs through conduction, where particles pass heat to their neighbors without moving positions. Metals like aluminium or iron are good conductors because they allow heat to pass easily, making them suitable for cooking utensils. In contrast, materials such as wood, glass, and clay are poor conductors (insulators) that do not allow heat to pass through them easily.
